prompt: You accidentally send a mildly complaining message about a family gathering to the family group chat itself, instead of to your friend, and relatives start reacting. What response best repairs it?

options.text: Claim your account was hacked and deny writing it
Own it quickly with a brief, honest apology in the chat and follow up privately with anyone most affected
Leave the group chat immediately and say nothing
Send a flood of unrelated messages to bury it

explanation: Owning a mistake quickly and apologising briefly is braver and more trusted than excuses, and a private follow-up shows real care.
